title: Which AI investing apps work with the brokerage you already have?
summary: Robo-advisors manage money you move to them and broker AI works with one broker. Apps like Astor connect to the accounts you already have.
body_markdown:
## Which AI apps read across all your accounts?


These connect through aggregators like Plaid, so your money stays where it is.


**Origin** connects brokerage, retirement and crypto accounts through partners including Plaid, MX and Mastercard, and says the connections are read-only by design. Its AI gives plain-language insights on allocation and risk alongside budgeting and planning, its advice is non-discretionary, and advisory services come through Origin Investment Advisory LLC, an SEC-registered adviser. It also offers its own investment accounts. As of October 2026 its homepage shows a limited-time price of $1 for the first year, against a listed $99.


**Perplexity** connects brokerage accounts through Plaid with read-only access, on desktop for signed-in users in the US and Canada. Basic portfolio features are free, and more advanced features are part of Pro and Max.


**ChatGPT** has a Finances feature for US users on its Free, Go, Plus and Pro plans that connects accounts through Plaid. OpenAI says ChatGPT can’t move money, place trades or act as an investment adviser.


Budgeting apps also aggregate investments. Monarch connects to more than 13,000 institutions and has an AI Assistant ($99.99 a year or $14.99 a month), and Empower’s dashboard is free.
